text:
hey i have a question to see if you can do it with effect or not. so lets say you have a 3x3 tile space. and so 

1 2 3
4 5 6
7 8 9 


say that tile 5 is a plasma effect
and tile 7 is a spin effect
tiles 1 2 3 4 6 8 9 are the same cloud effect lets say


can you blend this into one quad
resolution: Question answered: yes, a 3x3 tile space with mixed effects (plasma center, spin corner, cloud elsewhere) can render as ONE Effect quad. The fragment shader derives tile index from UV (floor(uv*3)), reads a 9-entry per-tile effect-id from the data storage buffer, runs the matching effect function, and blends at tile borders by bilinearly weighting neighboring tiles' effect ids — same data-driven pattern as cart/donut_demo.tsx. Demo cart offered, awaiting user go-ahead.
